opener_concept: 800 sweets, half vanish each day: student counts halvings by common sense, reveal names it as half-life (radioactive decay halves, never subtracts a fixed amount).

problems_fixed.what: String answer 'beta' cannot validate (solutions must be numeric). Converted to multiple_choice with options Alpha/Beta, solutions [1]; kept the decay-type-recognition pedagogy. No guided_steps needed for MC.

notes: No numeric answer was wrong: all 20 problems fresh-solved and confirmed (alpha mass -4/atomic -2, beta atomic +1, halving counts, 52/4=13, 2^7=128, chained Na-24 final mass 20, 480 count over 2h=120min gives 30 min, 50g over 5 half-lives=1.5625g). Only structural repair was the string-answer gold[2] -> MC. Added guided_steps walks to all 19 single_value problems with a phase:'substitute' completion boundary (set-up pre-worked, student finishes the solve plus a balance/multiply-back check that states the answer WITH UNIT). Unit-conversion box added where units are not base: gold[4] converts 2 hours to 120 minutes as its own box. Added tier_guides (bronze/silver/gold), guided.opener, guided.teach walks (Radon-222 alpha; 3200->200 half-life; U-238 alpha-then-beta chain), and per-tier _description fields. Added expect to every misconception (validator now requires the key): derived by committing the error (drop 2 not 4, go down not up on atomic number, miscount halvings by one, forget hour->minute conversion, use activity-ratio as the halving count, 2x7 instead of 2^7, only-one-decay); set expect null where indeterminate (gold[2] MC, gold[3] wrong_order gives identical mass, silver[4] 'subtracted' has no single value). Every expect verified outside the accept window. Removed em dashes from method_card content/steps, exam_context.frequency, gold[2] text, and worked_examples step labels (-> colon). Slimmed method_card content to <140 words. Preserved related_videos, topic_links, worked_examples (content unchanged bar em-dash label fix), exam_context, and all unit/accept/equation_hint fields. Tier ladder matches the science ladder: bronze single decay / whole half-lives, silver count+rearrange+convert, gold chained decays / fractions / awkward numbers. Board-neutral throughout: no board named, no equation-sheet claims. all_row_ids has a single id (this row); PATCH readback confirmed byte-identical.
